title: The Qur’an – the final revelation
intro: The first word revealed was “Read!” – the Qur’an is Allah’s last revelation, a guide for all people.

learn.text: Recite in the name of your Lord who created - Created man from a clinging substance. Recite, and your Lord is the most Generous - Who taught by the pen - Taught man that which he knew not.

learn.html: The Qur’an is Allah’s last revelation, revealed to Allah’s last messenger, Muhammad (SAW). It was revealed in Arabic, and it contains guidance and rules for the Islamic way of life, stories about earlier revelations, messengers and their peoples, and about life in the next world.
Muslims have a special duty to study the Qur’an and to live by its rules, because that is how they will find happiness in this world and the next.

items: The revelation began on Laylat al-Qadr, in the month of Ramadan, in the year 610, in the cave of Hira on the mountain Jabal an-Nur.
The first ayat revealed to Muhammad (SAW) were the ayat of Surah Al-‘Alaq.
The revelation lasted 23 years: 13 years in Makkah and 10 in Madinah.
The Qur’an has 114 surahs and over 6,000 ayat. It is divided into 30 juz’ – parts of 20 pages each.
The angel Jibril told Muhammad (SAW) where and how the surahs and ayat would be ordered in the Mushaf.

learn.alt: A rocky mountain with a cave, and a ribbon of night sky, palm trees and the earth rising from it

learn.text: How the Qur’an was written down

learn.html: When revelation came, Muhammad (SAW) at once called one of the scribes of the revelation and dictated it to him. The whole Qur’an was written down in the Prophet’s lifetime, but it was not yet gathered in one collection – a Mushaf. That was done in the time of the first caliph, Abu Bakr. This first copy was later given for safekeeping to the second caliph, ‘Umar, and after his death to the Prophet’s wife Hafsah.

The best-known translations of the Qur’an into Bosnian are by Mićo Ljubibratić (1895), Džemaludin Čaušević and hafiz Muhamed Pandža (1936), Ali Riza Karabeg (1937), Besim Korkut (1977), Mustafa Mlivo (1994), Enes Karić (1995), Esad Duraković (2004) and Nurko Karaman (2018). In our English lessons we use the translation Sahih International.

learn.title: Hadith
learn.html: The Prophet (SAW) said: “The Qur’an! In it is news of what came before you, news of what will come after you, and judgement on what is between you. It is clear speech, not a joke. Whoever leaves it out of arrogance, Allah will destroy; whoever seeks guidance in something else, Allah will leave astray. The Qur’an is Allah’s firm rope, the wise reminder and the straight path. Desires cannot twist it, nor can tongues change it. The learned never have enough of it, and it never wears out from being repeated. There is no end to its wonders. When the jinn heard it, they could not help saying: ‘We have indeed heard an amazing Qur’an, which guides to the right path.’ Whoever speaks by the Qur’an speaks the truth, whoever acts by it is rewarded, whoever judges by it is just, and whoever calls to it is guided to the Straight Path.” <small>(Tirmidhi)</small>

learn.text: The Qur’an is kept in three ways

items: in the Lawh al-Mahfuz – the Preserved Tablet with Allah (SWT),
by hifz – learning the Qur’an by heart, and

learn.html: Every Muslim should know as much of the Qur’an by heart as they can – at least as much as is needed for salah: Surah Al-Fatihah and four short surahs. Muhammad (SAW) said: “The most valuable worship of my ummah is reciting the Qur’an.” (Bayhaqi)

The Qur’an is the most-read book in the world, and one of the meanings of its name is “the Book for learning, reading and reciting”. The Qur’an also gives itself other names: Kitab – the Book, Furqan – what separates truth from falsehood, Dhikr – the Reminder, Haqq – the Truth, Nur – the Light, Huda – the Guidance, and others. In a Muslim’s life the Qur’an is a guide and a clear proof of what is true and what is false.

learn.text: a guidance for the people and clear proofs of guidance and criterion.

learn.title: ⭐ Remember
learn.html: The first task people were given by Allah (SWT) through the Qur’an was reading. That is why Muslims should give a lot of attention to education and knowledge.

practice.prompt: Tap the events in the right order.
items: The first ayat of Surah Al-‘Alaq in the cave of Hira (610)
The whole Qur’an written down by the scribes
Gathered in one Mushaf under Abu Bakr
